description:
Decision recorded by nightly-windows-unit-coverage-decision-20261008: nightly-v2 keeps Windows unit coverage. Add a T3 domain that runs the fast unit tier on windows-latest with Python 3.12 only (3.11 duplicates it), with its own issue label like the other domains and no continue-on-error, and add it to the report job and the domain loop. dlv2-70 must not delete nightly.yml until this domain has run green in a dispatched nightly-v2 run.

PR #2835 implements the domain: t3:windows, Python 3.12, timeout 50 minutes, no coverage. The 50-minute timeout was sized from a 38-minute run. The latest Windows 3.12 fast-test step took 47.7 minutes (run 37967682464, with coverage), so 50 minutes leaves almost no margin. Re-size the timeout from a no-coverage run before merging.

Do this after the Windows fixes pass, so the new domain does not start red. The Windows fast tier also stalls at 90-95% on Python 3.11 and 3.12 (windows-pytest-xdist-teardown-hang-20261009); that must be fixed first.

This item also takes over two parts of nightly-windows-path-quoting-20261008, which is being closed: the test_nightly_t3_workflow failure on Windows, and the close of issue #2568 (moved from nightly-windows-unquarantine-20261008).
